rule: Files an AI session reads often enough that a symbol index beats re-reading them. The map lets a reader grep to a line number, then Read(offset, limit), instead of pulling a 100 KB file whole.
why: Measured 2026-08-30 over 14 days: 2,443 file reads were repeats of a file already read in the same session. npdev_cli.py alone was read 371 times, 321 of those redundant; business-ui-app.mustache 164 times. 40% of all reads carried no offset/limit. Cost is (requests x average context), so a re-read is billed twice: once when it lands, and again on every later request in the session.

roots.note: npdev CLI - the single most re-read file in the corpus
business-ui-app.mustache and siblings - section names, not code symbols
